question: Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award is given for the spectacular and most outstanding performance in the field of sports by a sportsperson over a period of the previous four years. In 2021, the awardee for para shooting was:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Avani Lekhara**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Avani Lekhara** was awarded the Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award in 2021 for her outstanding performance in para shooting.
 
• She became the first Indian woman to win a **gold medal** in shooting at the Tokyo 2020 Paralympic Games.
 
• Avani won the gold medal in the **Women's 10m Air Rifle Standing (SH1)** event at the Paralympics with a record-breaking score.
 
• She also secured a **bronze medal** in the Women's 50m Rifle 3 Positions (SH1) event, making her the first Indian woman to win multiple medals at the Paralympics.
 
• Her achievements reflect resilience, determination, and contribution to para sports in India, earning her the prestigious award.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award:**

 
 
• The Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award is India’s highest sporting honor, established in 1991-1992.
 
• It is given to athletes for their spectacular and outstanding performance over the previous four years.
 
• The award consists of a medallion, certificate, and a cash prize of Rs. 25 lakh.
 
 
 
• **Para Shooting Classification:**
 
 
• The SH1 classification is for athletes who have an impairment that affects their legs but allows them to support the rifle without any aids.
 
• Events are conducted in different positions, such as standing, kneeling, and prone.
 
 
 
• **Tokyo 2020 Paralympics:**
 
 
• The Tokyo Paralympics were held from August 24 to September 5, 2021.
 
• India achieved its best-ever medal tally in a single Paralympic Games with 19 medals, including 5 golds.
 
 
 
• **Other Indian Paralympic Achievers in 2021:**
 
 
• Neeraj Chopra won India’s first-ever Olympic gold in athletics but was not a Paralympian.
 
• Chanu Saikhom Mirabai secured a silver medal at the Tokyo Olympics in weightlifting.
 
• Other notable Paralympic medalists include Sumit Antil (gold in javelin throw) and Krishna Nagar (gold in badminton).
